resources.title: Rules of the Road
resources.summary: Core duties, right-of-way, following distance, overtaking, parking and freeway rules.
highlights: Pedestrians must be given priority at crossings.
Keep a safe following distance and do not tailgate.
Overtaking must be done only when it is safe and legal.

resources.title: Road Traffic Signs
resources.summary: A practical guide to regulatory, warning, guidance and temporary sign meanings.
highlights: Regulatory signs control behaviour and may be compulsory or prohibitive.
Warning signs alert you to hazards ahead.
Temporary signs are used at road works, crashes and school zones.

resources.title: Vehicle Controls
resources.summary: Vehicle control principles, mirrors, indicators, braking and safe movement basics.
highlights: Use indicators before changing direction or lane.
Check mirrors regularly and before any manoeuvre.
Always keep full control of the vehicle and your line of sight.
